title: Bogomolov–Gieseker Inequality for Tilt-Semistable Threefold Complexes
exact_target: BG inequality conjecture: let $X$ be a smooth projective threefold over $\mathbb C$, let $B,\omega\in\operatorname{NS}(X)_{\mathbb Q}$ with $\omega$ ample, and let $E$ be tilt-semistable with $\nu_{\omega,B}(E)=0$. Then $\operatorname{ch}^{B}_{3}(E)\leq\frac{1}{18}\operatorname{ch}^{B}_{1}(E)\cdot\omega^{2}$. The conjecture is known for $X=\mathbb P^{3}$, smooth quadrics, and étale quotients of abelian threefolds.
